title: Effects of Physical Exercise and Cognitive Training on Quality of Life in Older Women
official: Effects of Cognitive Training and Exercise on Cognitive Function in Older Women: the INCOGNITO Randomized Clinical Trial
summary: Ageing exposes people to a progressive loss of cognitive and functional abilities, especially in women. The aim of the study is to investigate the effectiveness of different types of intervention, based on physical exercise and/or cognitive stimulation or training, on quality of life, cognition and mobility, on a population of older women.

interventions.name: EXERCISE TRAINING WITH OR WITHOUT MEDICATION
Exercise plus cognitive stimulus at home

criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Female
* Age ≥ 60 years
* Provision of the informed consent form

Exclusion Criteria:

* Absolute contraindications to physical exercise (e.g. Nyha class iv heart failure, unstable angina, etc.)
* Pregnancy
* Severe cognitive impairment, defined as a MoCa score ≤ 12
* Severe visual impairment or blindness
